relationships.subject: 3,5-dicaffeoylquinic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: 3,5-DCQA suppressed LPS-induced MCP3 expression, resulting in reduced phosphorylation of JAK2/STAT3.

relationships.subject: MCP3
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings indicate that 3,5-DCQA attenuates inflammation-mediated pain hypersensitivity by enhancing autophagy through inhibition of MCP3-induced JAK2/STAT3 signaling.

relationships.subject: JAK2/STAT3 signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: Interestingly, the suppressed JAK2/STAT3 signaling enhanced autophagy induction in BV2 cells.

relationships.subject: 3,5-dicaffeoylquinic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: The CFA-induced pain hypersensitivity and foot swelling were attenuated by the oral administration of 3,5-DCQA.

key_findings: 3,5-DCQA suppresses MCP3-driven JAK2/STAT3 signaling in microglia, enhancing autophagy and reducing inflammatory responses.
Oral 3,5-DCQA attenuates CFA-induced pain hypersensitivity and spinal microglial activation in mice.
